text:
[name]
Madison, WI | [email] | [phone] | [url]

EDUCATION
University of Wisconsin–Madison — Madison, WI
B.A. in Political Science, Certificate in Public Policy, expected May 2027 | GPA 3.84 / 4.00
Letters and Science Honors Program; Dean's List every semester since Fall 2023
Coursework: American Politics, Public Policy Analysis, Statistics for Social Science, Constitutional Law, State and Local Government, Legislative Process
Honors thesis in progress on county-level turnout effects of early-voting site placement in Wisconsin (adviser in the political science department)

EXPERIENCE

Wisconsin State Senate — Legislative Intern, Office of a State Senator (Committee on Health)
Madison, WI | January 2026 – May 2026 (20 hours a week during the session)
- Wrote 23 policy memos on health, workforce and local-government bills for the senator and the chief of staff; 4 were used in committee hearing preparation
- Prepared briefing packets for 11 committee hearings, including witness summaries and amendment comparisons
- Drafted 60+ constituent response letters and tracked about 400 constituent contacts in the office's casework system
- Staffed 3 town halls (about 80 attendees each) and wrote the follow-up summaries sent to attendees
- Researched and summarized peer-state approaches to rural EMS funding for a bill the senator introduced in April 2026

Associated Students of Madison (student government) — Chair, Shared Governance Committee
Madison, WI | May 2025 – Present
- Elected chair of a 9-member committee that nominates students to 40 university committees and reviews policy proposals affecting students
- Led two resolutions to passage by the 33-member Student Council: expanded late-night campus bus hours (adopted by the transportation office for Fall 2025) and a syllabus-posting deadline (adopted by the faculty senate in 2026)
- Ran 14 committee meetings; filled 92% of student seats on university committees, up from 71% the prior year

University of Wisconsin–Madison Recreation and Wellbeing — Student Facility Supervisor
Madison, WI | September 2024 – Present
- Supervise 8 to 12 student staff per shift at a 230,000-square-foot recreation facility; handle incidents, opening and closing, and shift reports
- Trained 15 new building attendants in 2025 on emergency procedures and customer service
- Promoted from building attendant to supervisor after one year

Wisconsin Club Ultimate (women's club team) — Captain
Madison, WI | September 2025 – Present (member since 2023)
- Captain of a 28-player roster; plan practices with two co-captains and manage a $14,000 season budget including travel to 5 tournaments
- Team qualified for the 2026 college regional championship for the first time in four seasons

LEADERSHIP AND AWARDS
- Wisconsin Academic Excellence Scholarship (four-year merit award), 2023 – 2027
- Honors Program Sophomore Research Apprenticeship, 2024 – 2025: coded 1,800 municipal clerk survey responses for a faculty study on election administration
- Volunteer, Dane County voter registration drives, 2024 and 2025 (about 60 hours)

SKILLS
Policy writing and memo drafting, legislative research, Stata and R (introductory), Excel, Google Workspace, public speaking; conversational Spanish
